name: Clever Puppetry
body:
School: enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level: jester 2

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Prop: Marotte

EFFECT

Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)

Area: 10-ft.-radius burst

Duration: 1 round

Saving Throw: Will negates; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

Each creature in the burst is driven (as the condition) until the end of your next turn. If you are wielding a marotte, the target also takes a penalty to damage rolls equal to your Charisma modifier until the end of your next turn.
